name: ai-cut
description: AI 可操作的网页剪辑工作台 — 命令层先行，UI 与 AI 共用一套命令

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-cut/server && npm run build --workspace @ai-cut/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-cut/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-cut/web
